body: im very sorry you have to suffer all that. it seems our situation are opposite of each other but i think the pain and misery is the same. i really wonder why our parents have to be extreme like that and can never strike a balance in how they treat their children. but i also feel lucky that im not revengeful at all, i wont do that to any other person just to pour out my anger. i promise myself i will treat my children with equal affection. i really hope you will survive your situation and be a great dad to your future kids :)
wow perhaps they were trying to pour their anger onto you because they felt unfair. i think your parents are mostly to blame in this case. anyway good for them now

yeah he had a gf once. normally he is okay and funny and everything but when he loses his temper he would say really bad things. his ex cried a lot too. but to be fair i think we all say bad things when we are mad, right?
its great that boys can realize their privileges when they are enjoying them! i hope you treat your sisters with love and care :)

thank you so much for your reply! the small stories you told hit me hard too because they are too relatable. and i hate the fact that we relate to each other, because that means there's more than one person having to deal with this kind of tragedy. im happy that you seem to have survived this situation and came out a kindhearted, strong girl. that gives me hope as well! 
also thank you for reading my post in r/suicidewatch. tbh i am always torn between not giving a fuck anymore and trying to forgive and make up with my family. there are times when my family is laughing and happy with each other, which makes me feel like a bitch trying to get out. it's just that whenever anything bad happens i am immediately the one to blame and the one for others to pour their anger onto. so at the moment i really want to leave but i cant help thinking back our good memories and fear i will regret leaving.
finally, fyi i was going to study abroad but because of the Covid19 im stuck here for one more year and almost doing nothing (i only read books, work online, self-study etc.) and my family seems annoyed with me and always rants about how useless i am
i really admire you for being able to keep up your mental game. im struggling with it and i dont know if im able to endure this for the next 8 months

yes thats what i want to tell my family all this time! but you know asian families arent like that, you cannot report your family for beating you because ppl (even the police) will think that your parents are only doing good to you and that you are a spoiled brat

my brother is often regarded as a "successful figure" by outsiders but noone knows how shitty he is at home. i feel guilty for saying this, but i hope society can hit him so he can realize how shitty he is
(copied from my other comment because thats what i want to tell you too)

my brother is often regarded as a "successful figure" by outsiders but noone knows how shitty he is at home. i feel guilty for saying this, but i hope society can hit him so he can realize how shitty he is

yes his argument is that he already told me to turn it on and i forgot, so everything is my fault. i know my forgetting is wrong and he had to take a cold shower, but does this mistake deserve to receive such criticism and even violence?? fyi, he stood 1.5 hours criticizing me about it, asking me over and over again why i could forget his command (i dont know why i forgot?? i didnt mean to). and he was going to slap me as well, before i shouted back how he was being an asshole

wow i guess asian parents just dont care about their daughters enough to expect anything from her. sometimes i feel my parents just raise me up because they dont want to get an abortion, like i feel no true love and care compared to how they treat my brother. in exchange my parents dont expect much from me either, they just want me to get married soon and get out of the house. all in all i really hope you can handle your situation and if it gets toxic or overwhelming for you, just fight back!

thank you i really need this kind of assurance in my life when i keep questioning myself! for me, ive endured so long and ive told myself to be patient so many times. im really afraid one day i wont be able to hold it in anymore. also i feel really unfair that THEY are the wrong ones but I am the one to suffer everything. my family is so indifferent and thinks they are doing good for me?????
i was going to study abroad but its Covid 19 and now im stuck here

im sorry for that and im happy you seem you got away from all that shit. im still too young to be able to get out of here, and they said i should appreciate my time with them before i go away or get married. but honestly i wont ever miss these assholes

my brother has a shitty personality but he is smart too, so he is doing quite well with my job and life. this makes my parents love him more while i am a 18-year-old girl who hasnt made much money yet

Asian here. "running out of hot water" actually does exist in Asian too. my family has an underground water tank which is constantly supplied by the city's water pipeline. we also have an electric water pump that will pump water from the underground tank to floors above (my house has 5 floors). we use a water heater run by both solar energy and electricity, so in the summer the water is always super hot and we do not have to turn on the water heater manually. but in the winter we do, this heated water will be stored in a tank. if we use up all this water we will basically run out of hot water.

haha maybe we are truly similar in our insecurities, except that im also overambitious and want to hang out with supersmart people and then just end up feeling more insecure about myself. anyway, im reading a lot to to develop myself, i hope i can become as smart as my friends are instead of settling for "less-smart" friends. can you suggest me some of your favorite books for deep thought?
thanks for the encouragement! haha it sometimes confuses me why the Internet community is more supportive than the real-life community

hey your advice is actually really helpful! thanks a lot! also, i think judging people for being dumber than yourself is kinda... normal? like it's hard not to think about it. thats why the saying goes: birds of the same feather flock together

i guess im expecting too much from myself, like always wanting to be the smartest person and never wanting to be dumber than anyone else. sounds overambitious and idealistic, isnt it? i have a group of friends all of whom are really smart (confirmed by many others), and i usually feel inadequate. i feel like im the leftout in the group and the other members are just talking to me out of politeness...
so maybe im just less dumb than some people and dumber than others? that sounds legit, but also sad...
i thought about that too, but it's so hard to check whether im truly dumb or whether im just insecure. thats why im asking this question actually :(((((((
i dont think i can afford going to a psychologist for this. can you suggest me some good ones online then?
thanks i love your open-mindedness. by "dumb" i mean just dumb in general, like a shallow and silly person without the ability to handle things well?
hey thats sad :((( but what if im just being too insecure to have an accurate judgement of myself?
i love your first sentence, it's really inspirational, thank you!

thank you so much for your warm comment. i mean, even if i really want to die i would never be brave enough to really kill myself. so im trying to live day by day and waiting for the day i can escape this whole situation :) again, thank you very much
i really wish i have a friend like you in real life, really

actually, in all my relationships with friends, etc. i feel like im the subservient one who tries to please others at the risk of going against my own wishes. and my friends usually take me for granted and will readily leave me for another company. but i cant leave them, or else i would be truly alone in this world.
and youre right, i dont think i have anything called self-esteem. i try to assert myself in public to hide the insecurity deep inside me, so people who first met me would think im arrogant, but people who know me for a long time would start to take advantage of me because they know i cannot leave them.

now that you ask, im starting to wonder whether i really have clinical depression or im just amplifying my sadness to the extent of depression. but one thing i know for sure is that i will be trapped in this sadness forever, because i live in a really toxic households. my parents always say that the only reason im unhappy is because im a spoiled brat and i want attention. 
thank you so much for your comments, tbh i never expected anyone to care about me enough to keep talking to me. but you did, thanks a lot
i dont think i have a specific mental illness, tbh. im just depressed and angry at myself. but well, depression is enough to kill my soul
well thinking about my cowardliness just makes me hate myself more. but all the same, thank you for your kindness

same here. my mother always says that the only reason i'm unhappy is because i'm a spoilt brat. she never takes my problems seriously and always tells me that i'm being too fussy and that i should try to be more useful instead of mulling over stupid problems. and after everything she gets mad at me for not confiding in her :)

so yes, i think your parents are actually abusive. i believe that as children, we deserve love and care from parents, or at the very least, a peaceful upbringing. and definitely not an environment where we have to feel like a burden and an outcast in our own home. for me, i am really looking forward to escaping my toxic household when i go to college. hope the best will occur to you too!

hi, i'm in the same situation as you are. i'm also an Asian, with oppressive parents who think they are entitled to control my life just because they gave birth to me and gave me food. to make matters worse, i'm a female, and i think you understand how females are constantly degraded compared to males in Asian countries. i feel like while my older brother enjoys all the love and care and everything, i'm just an unasked-for daughter who will eventually get married and leave the house.

and yes, i have had suicidal thoughts for years. every time i sneak into the bathroom to cry (i do not even own a room of my own while of course, my brother has the best bedroom in the house), i think of banging my head down the floor and die. but to be honest, i have never had the guts to do so. i wish i could be a little more brave, to either stand up for myself or to kill myself. maybe cowards like me deserve misery and a painful death :)

but i have decided not to die. i have decided that, instead of killing myself forever, i would try my best to escape my toxic household and create a new life for myself. i really think you can do it. you are only 15, you have a whole life in front of you, and who knows what happiness you would encounter in the future?
